about.title: About the Game
about.subtitle: Get to Know Us
about.description: Deceit Online is a multiplayer Arabic game based on hidden roles, deception, alliances, and special abilities. The game is designed for groups of friends who enjoy strategy and social deduction games.
about.gameDescription: Deceit is a multiplayer social deception game. Each player gets a secret role and special ability, then tries to read others' intentions and make the right decisions before one team wins the battle.

step1.title: Get Your Secret Role
step1.description: At the start of the game, you get one secret role: either from the Kingdom (good) or from the Shadows (evil). Each role has its own special ability, like protection, killing, investigation, or sabotage.

step2.title: Use Your Ability at Night
step2.description: Every night, your role uses its ability secretly: Shadows attack, while the Kingdom protects and investigates. No one knows what you did at night, and all events are revealed during the day.

step3.title: Discuss and Vote During the Day
step3.description: During the day, discuss with players what happened, gather evidence, and spot contradictions. Then vote to kick out the player you think is from the Shadows. Beware: Shadows lie to hide their identity!

tip.title: 💡 Tips for Beginners
tip.description: The key to winning isn't just knowing the roles, but watching who talks too much, who avoids answering, and who defends certain players. Be smart in choosing who to trust!

cycle.title: Day & Night Cycle
cycle.subtitle: The Cycle of Deception
cycle.description: The game revolves in repeating cycles: night where abilities are used secretly, then day for discussion and voting.

night.title: Night
night.point1: Each character uses their ability in turn.
night.point2: Shadows secretly agree on the night's target.
night.point3: Some abilities protect, some deceive, some kill.

day.title: Day
day.point1: Players discuss what happened during the night.
day.point2: Accusations intersect with evidence and suspicions.
day.point3: Group voting decides who gets kicked out of the game.

cycle.quote: The game is not measured by knowing the roles only, but by understanding what happened in the darkness... and why it happened.

goals.title: Winning Conditions
goals.subtitle: Path to Victory
goals.description: Each team has its own path to victory. Understand your team's win condition to succeed.

kingdom.title: Kingdom Victory
kingdom.description: Eliminate all Shadow members while keeping the King alive until the end of the match.

shadows.title: Shadows Victory
shadows.description: Eliminate the King (and Crown Prince if applicable) to claim victory over the Kingdom.

neutral.title: Neutral Victory
neutral.description: Each neutral character has their own unique winning condition, independent of the main teams.

cta.title: The Throne Awaits… Who Will Rule?
cta.desc: Join the Kingdom or scheme among the Shadows — Download now.

footer.tagline: A game of lies and suspicion… trust no one.

roles.subtitle: Choose Your Allegiance
roles.title: The Roles
roles.description: Discover the characters, abilities, and hidden motives that shape every game.

King.name: King
King.desc: King, the ruler of the kingdom, decisions determine everyone's fate. Important and influential leadership role.

Guard.name: Guard
Guard.desc: Protects one player from any attack during the night. Basic defensive role for the kingdom.

Doctor.name: Doctor
Doctor.desc: Treats players who are injured or at risk of death. Essential for countering poison and killing abilities.

Investigator.name: Investigator
Investigator.desc: Gathers information to reveal a player's true role. Helps discover Shadows.

Knight.name: Knight
Knight.desc: Brave warrior defending the kingdom with strength. Possesses combat abilities and protective skills.

Royal Guard.name: Royal Guard
Royal Guard.desc: Personal guard for the king, protects royal family members.

Judge.name: Judge
Judge.desc: Judges disputes and decides fate. Plays a crucial role in pivotal decisions.

Vizier.name: Vizier
Vizier.desc: King's advisor, manages kingdom affairs. Holds great influence and knowledge.

Priest.name: Priest
Priest.desc: Guides people and performs religious rituals. May have spiritual abilities or special knowledge.

Messenger.name: Messenger
Messenger.desc: Transmits messages and secret communications between parties. Important for coordination and secret communication.

Wizard.name: Wizard
Wizard.desc: Possesses magical knowledge and mysterious abilities. Has a unique ability that can change the game's course.

Citizen.name: Citizen
Citizen.desc: Ordinary kingdom inhabitant. No special abilities, but vote is important in voting.

Crown Prince.name: Crown Prince
Crown Prince.desc: Heir to the throne, ready to take power when the king falls.

Trickster.name: Trickster
Trickster.desc: A character who tries to convince players they are a threat or part of an opposing team, until eliminated by vote.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.desc: Silent killer from the shadows. Can eliminate targets during the night with precise strikes.

Poisoner.name: Poisoner
Poisoner.desc: Master of toxins and deadly substances. Can poison players over time, causing delayed death.

Saboteur.name: Saboteur
Saboteur.desc: Disrupts abilities and interferes with plans. Can disable key abilities at crucial moments.

Deceiver.name: Deceiver
Deceiver.desc: Expert at spreading misinformation and confusion. Can manipulate perceptions and create false narratives.

Shadow Leader.name: Shadow Leader
Shadow Leader.desc: Commands the Shadows with authority. Coordinates attacks and strategies for maximum impact.

Whisperer.name: Whisperer
Whisperer.desc: Communicates secretly with Shadows. Can share information without detection.

Spy.name: Spy
Spy.desc: Monitors a specific player and reveals interactions during the night. Helps in knowing who moves and active players.

Forger.name: Forger
Forger.desc: Corrupts investigation results, turning truth upside down. Makes investigators see false information.

Impersonator.name: Impersonator
Impersonator.desc: Copies another player's ability to use for one night only. Allows temporary use of any ability.

Slasher.name: Slasher
Slasher.desc: Chooses a player each night to kill. If successful, the target dies normally. If failed, Slasher's ability enters a one-night cooldown.

interactions.subtitle: When Abilities Collide
interactions.title: Interactions
interactions.description: Every ability can change the course of the night. Learn how powers meet, counter, and combine.
